title: Blue Ridge Parkway
direction: Runs south from Rockfish Gap near Waynesboro, Virginia, along the Blue Ridge to Cherokee, North Carolina, at the edge of the Great Smoky Mountains.

sources.driveTimes: OSRM (router.project-osrm.org), OpenStreetMap data, computed at build time; excludes stops and traffic

moments.title: Mabry Mill
moments.text: A restored gristmill beside the parkway in Virginia.

photo.title: Mabry Mill.jpg
photo.alt: The wooden Mabry Mill and its waterwheel beside a millpond.
photo.author: Pfolmsbee

moments.title: Linn Cove Viaduct
moments.text: A curving bridge that carries the road around the slope of Grandfather Mountain.

photo.title: Linn Cove Viaduct in the Autumn.jpg
photo.alt: Linn Cove Viaduct curving around a mountainside in autumn colour.
photo.author: Goins

moments.title: Craggy Gardens
moments.text: Open, rhododendron-covered summits north of Asheville.
